Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025. The Group offers high value-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
  
  
Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA.
  
  
**The Position**
IT/Telecom global category manager H/F
  
  
**Job Summary**
**CONTEXTE**
Le département des achats du Groupe Imerys est une organisation mondiale gérant environ 3 milliards de dollars/an. Au sein de cette organisation, la Direction des Achats Indirects gère tous les achats liés aux fournitures et services généraux. Les dépenses indirectes s'élèvent à environ 500 millions d'euros dans le monde. La Direction des Achats Indirects est composée de 9 personnes administrant et gérant des catégories au niveau mondial ou géographique.
  
  

* Directeur(trice) des Achats Indirects en France
* 3 Responsables mondiaux de catégories (France)
* 3 Responsables de catégories (France ; États-Unis)
* 2 Chefs de projets

**La Direction Des Achats Indirects Vise à**

* Soutenir ses parties prenantes internes (toutes les fonctions)
* Définir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d'approvisionnement
* Mener des activités de sourcing stratégique (RFI, RFP,...)
* Réaliser des économies ; générer une optimisation des coûts
* Mettre en œuvre et suivre les accords-cadres (Master Agreements) avec les fournisseurs clés
* Mener des activités de gestion de catégories (suivi des fournisseurs, revues d'activité…)
* Démontrer son expertise dans la gestion de projets de création (greenfields)

**OBJECTIF**
Le/la IT/Telecom global category manager est le point de contact principal de la fonction informatique (IT) d'Imerys. La fonction IT d'Imerys étant centralisée, tous les besoins des parties prenantes internes sont soumis à l'approbation des directeurs informatiques. Le/la responsable mondial(e) de catégorie IT/Télécom gère le processus d'achat de bout en bout pour tous les projets. Les catégories gérées sont : logiciels ; matériel informatique ; services informatiques ; I.O.T (Internet des objets) ; télécommunications (services et appareils). Le portefeuille est d'environ 50 millions d'euros. Les responsabilités comprennent, sans s'y limiter :
  
  

* Gérer les demandes de propositions/d'informations (RFX) correspondant à la feuille de route informatique/aux besoins de l'entreprise (+30 appels d'offres/an).
* Gérer les renouvellements de contrats ; les renégociations (avec le soutien du service juridique).
* Identifier, proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions TCO (coût total de possession).
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les régions (EMEA/NORAM/LATAM/APAC) pour définir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies régionales avec le soutien des responsables des achats régionaux.
* Assurer le suivi des fournisseurs par le biais de revues d'activité.
* Contribuer aux objectifs de développement durable d'Imerys ; générer des idées autour de la durabilité.
* Gestion directe du/de la responsable de catégorie IT.

**RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES**

job.description:
**Depuis 1822,**
**La Maison Nicolas**
perpétue une tradition d’excellence et de convivialité autour du vin. Leader du marché et premier réseau de cavistes en France,
**Maison**
**Nicolas**
compte

Nos cavistes, véritables ambassadeurs de la marque, partagent chaque jour leur passion du vin, leur expertise reconnue et leur sens du service pour offrir à chaque client une expérience unique, empreinte de proximité et de conseil personnalisé.

* Des avantages sur nos produits

job.title: International Category Manager (Associate experience) - (M/F/X) @ HelloFresh (Paris, Île-de-France, France)
job.description:
**The Role : What’s in the Box**
We are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe.
  
  
As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.
  
  
This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging.
  
  
You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.
  
  
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.
  
  
**What You'll Do : The Recipe**

* Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.
* Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.
* Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.
* Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.
* Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.
* Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.
* Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.
* Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.
* Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.
* Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
* Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.

**What we offer: The Toppings**

* The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe
* A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA
* A guaranteed steep learning curve and boost for your career
* A passionate, proactive, driven and dynamic French team
* Offices located in the center of Paris (Paris 1er)
* Competitive compensation
* Delicious reductions on our HelloFresh boxes
* Top tier employee experience and employees perks (Alan Blue insurance, Swile (tickets restaurant), GymLib, reductions on transport)

* Monitor market developments, competitor activity, customer trends, and opportunities within the salmon and seafood logistics sector.

* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information within the relevant CRM and company systems.

  .

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior decision-makers and develop long-term customer partnerships.
* Strong understanding of air freight and international logistics solutions.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities.

If you would like to become a valued member of the team, we will make sure that you’re rewarded for your commitment and expertise. As proud holders of the Gold Covenant, we are a forces-friendly employer who recognise the skills, expertise and value service leavers bring to our organisation.

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At the Client, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference.

job.title: Business Development Manager @ Hartmann Young (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
Hartmann Young is working with a fast-growing, profitable European CDMO to appoint a commercially driven Business Development Manager for the Benelux region.

This is a true hunter role, focused on accelerating new customer acquisition across the Netherlands initially, with scope to expand into the wider Benelux and Northern European markets over time. You will open doors, build relationships with ambitious brands and convert customer needs into development and manufacturing opportunities across multiple European production sites.

This is not an account-management position. We are looking for someone who enjoys the chase, is credible in front of founders and senior stakeholders, and can turn early conversations into long-term commercial partnerships.

**The opportunity**

You will target established nutraceutical, functional food and sports nutrition brands, alongside fast-growing challenger and founder-led businesses with the potential to become tomorrow’s category leaders.

Working closely with the Chief Global Sales Officer, European commercial colleagues, R&D and operational teams, you will represent a broad range of development and manufacturing capabilities. You will act as a trusted innovation partner, understanding customer ambitions and translating them into practical product, formulation and manufacturing solutions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Proactively identify, approach and win new customers across the Netherlands and wider Benelux region.
* Build a balanced pipeline of larger strategic accounts and smaller, high-potential growth brands.
* Open doors with founders, CEOs, product developers, procurement teams and other senior decision-makers.
* Understand formulations, formats, claims, market trends and customer product ambitions.
* Translate customer requirements into clear development and manufacturing opportunities for European sites.
* Act as the bridge between customers, R&D, product development, operations and commercial teams.
* Partner with the wider European sales organisation on cross-site and multi-format opportunities.
* Maintain a structured, high-quality pipeline and handover process through HubSpot CRM.
* Identify relevant industry events, marketing initiatives and other commercial opportunities to accelerate regional growth.
* Travel regularly across the Netherlands and to European production and commercial sites.

**What success looks like**

* A strong pipeline of qualified opportunities built within the first three to six months.
* New strategic customer relationships established across the Benelux market.
* Opportunities converted into valuable, long-term manufacturing partnerships.
* Credibility internally as a collaborative commercial partner and externally as a knowledgeable representative of an innovation-led CDMO.
* A clear contribution to the growth of the business across the region.

**About you**

* Proven new-business sales experience within nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, functional food, sports nutrition or a closely related industry.
* A genuine hunter mentality: resilient, proactive and comfortable with outbound business development.
* Able to engage credibly with both commercial and technical stakeholders.
* Commercially sharp, technically curious and confident discussing product innovation.
* Comfortable navigating longer, development-led CDMO sales cycles.
* Entrepreneurial, self-driven, ambitious and low ego.
* Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple sites, functions and countries.
* Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM would be beneficial.

**Essential requirements**

* Fluent Dutch and English.
* Based in the Netherlands, or able to operate effectively in a hybrid/remote role with significant regional travel.
* Willingness to spend regular time at production sites to develop a deep understanding of the company’s capabilities.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially ambitious individual to make a tangible impact within a high-growth European manufacturing business, with genuine autonomy and strong internal support.

For a confidential conversation, please contact Hartmann Young.

job.title: Business Development Manager - Autoimmunity @ Kinara Group (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
**Business Development Manager, Autoimmunity**

**Territory: Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg**

**The Opportunity**

An established international diagnostics company is seeking a Business Development Manager to grow its autoimmunity business across Benelux.

You will develop new business and expand existing customer relationships across hospital laboratories and private diagnostic groups. Combining technical knowledge with a proactive commercial approach, you will support customers in improving their testing capabilities and laboratory workflows.

This position offers ownership of territory development, from identifying opportunities through to evaluation, negotiation and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a commercial growth plan for autoimmunity across Benelux.
* Identify and secure new customers while expanding business within existing accounts.
* Build relationships with laboratory directors, clinical biologists, immunologists and procurement teams.
* Understand customer needs across assay performance, test menus, automation and workflow efficiency.
* Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, presentations, proposals, tenders and negotiations.
* Coordinate demonstrations and product evaluations with application specialists.
* Work closely with marketing, applications and service colleagues to support implementation and customer satisfaction.
* Track competitor activity, market developments and purchasing cycles.
* Maintain accurate pipelines, account plans and sales forecasts.
* Represent the business at industry events and customer meetings.

**Your Background**

* Commercial experience within in vitro diagnostics, ideally with a focus on autoimmunity.
* Knowledge of autoimmune testing technologies, assays and laboratory workflows.
* A track record of winning new business and developing key accounts.
* Experience navigating hospital and private laboratory purchasing processes.
* Confidence engaging technical, clinical and procurement stakeholders.
* Strong presentation, negotiation and relationship building skills.
* A proactive approach and the ability to manage a territory independently.
* A relevant scientific qualification or equivalent industry experience.
* Dutch, French and English language capabilities would be valuable.
* Willingness to travel regularly across Benelux.

**Why Apply?**

An opportunity to take ownership of a specialist diagnostic portfolio across three markets, combining new business development with strategic account growth and close collaboration with technical experts.

job.title: Project / Strategisch inkoper @ Selo (Hengelo OV, OV, NL)
Category Manager @ Stiho (Utrecht, Utrecht, Netherlands)
job.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Category Manager en wil jij bijdragen aan een onderscheidend en duurzaam product- en dienstenaanbod bij een toonaangevende bouwgroothandel?
  
  
Als Category Manager bij Stiho weet jij precies wat er nodig is om invulling te geven aan de Stiho-formule en deze te vertalen naar omnichannel categorie businessplannen. Bij alles wat je doet start je vanuit onze merkbelofte ‘Tijd voor het echte werk’ en stel je de wensen van de klant centraal, zodat onze bouwers de tijd hebben om de handen uit de mouwen te steken.
  
  
Je vertaalt de behoeften van onze diverse persona’s, marktontwikkelingen en trends naar concrete plannen en geeft daarmee invulling aan onze positionering ‘Meer bouwvermogen’. Je hebt jouw ervaring als Category Manager bij voorkeur opgedaan binnen meerdere organisaties in de groothandel en/of retailmarkt en hebt hierin aantoonbare successen behaald.
  
  
**Wat ga je doen?**
In deze rol ben jij de spin in het web en werk je intensief samen met leveranciers en collega’s van onder andere marketing, formule, commercie, inkoop, supply chain en uiteraard onze vestigingen.
  
  
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de categorieën
**Lijmen & Kitten, Installatiemateriaal en Hang- & Sluitwerk**
. Om verdere invulling te geven aan Stiho's fundament ‘Alles onder één dak’ ligt binnen deze categorieën de komende jaren een aanzienlijk groeipotentieel.
  
  
Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
  
  

* Het ontwikkelen en implementeren van categorie businessplannen, waarbij de rol van de categorie het uitgangspunt vormt.
* Het maken van scherpe assortimentskeuzes op basis van artikelprestaties en in lijn met de assortimentstrategie.
* Het zorgen voor assortiment- en merkkeuzes die optimaal aansluiten op de behoeften van verschillende klantgroepen.
* Het optimaliseren van de klantreis door data-analyses en marktinzichten te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen.
* Het realiseren van een renderend en duurzaam assortiment dat Stiho onderscheidend maakt in de markt.
* Het naar een hoger niveau brengen van schappresentaties op onze Bouwpleinen en de online zichtbaarheid van assortimenten op Stiho.nl.
* Het begeleiden van de introductie van nieuwe producten en concepten, van assortimentsopname tot aankoop door de klant, inclusief evaluatiemomenten.
* Het analyseren en rapporteren van de prestaties van jouw categorieën, waaronder omzet, marge en omloopsnelheid, en het bijsturen waar nodig.
* Het volgen van marktontwikkelingen en trends en deze vertalen naar commerciële kansen.
* Het versterken van de samenwerking en partnerships tussen Stiho, leveranciers en klanten.
* Het samenwerken met diverse interne stakeholders om categorieprestaties continu te verbeteren.

**Wat krijg je?**

* Een salaris tussen de € 4.500 en € 5.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur.
* 25 vakantiedagen en 12 ATV-dagen per jaar.
* Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
* Pensioenregeling en aantrekkelijke collectieve verzekeringen.
* Personeelskorting op ons assortiment bij Stiho, Bouwmaat en Baars & Bloemhoff.
* Aandelen in ons moederbedrijf DSG.
* Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden om jouw carrière verder vorm te geven.
* Hybride werken, waarbij je deels op kantoor en deels vanuit huis kunt werken.

**Wie ben jij?**
Je bent een gedreven Category Manager met een passie voor bouwmaterialen, assortimenten en productontwikkeling. Daarnaast:
  
  

* Heb je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in category management binnen retail en/of de (bouw)groothandel.
* Beschik je over een hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.
* Ben je resultaatgericht, ondernemend en heb je oog voor detail.
* Heb je bij voorkeur ervaring binnen de bouwsector.
* Heb je ervaring met het intensief samenwerken met leveranciers om category businessplannen succesvol te realiseren.
* Werk je gestructureerd en weet je verschillende stakeholders samen te brengen om commerciële successen te behalen.
* Ben je analytisch sterk en in staat om data om te zetten naar concrete acties en resultaten.

**Waar ga je werken?**
Stiho is dé specialist in bouwmaterialen, hout en plaatmateriaal en levert dagelijks aan bouwend Nederland. Met 26 vestigingen ondersteunen we professionals met materialen, advies en service. We zijn een organisatie met een sterke familiecultuur waarin eigen initiatief wordt gewaardeerd.
  
  
Stiho is onderdeel van DSG, het moederbedrijf achter Stiho, Baars & Bloemhoff, Broeinest en Bouwmaat. Met deze formules bedienen we diverse klanten in de bouw met materialen, gereedschappen, diensten, advies en inspiratie. Onze ambitie? De bebouwde wereld iedere dag een stukje mooier en duurzamer maken.
  
  
Klinkt dit als jouw volgende uitdaging? Solliciteer dan direct en maak impact als Category Manager bij Stiho!
  
  
#stiho

job.title: Category Manager – Asian Food @ Joybuy
job.description:
**About the Team**

You’ll be joining JD.com’s European retail team, where collaboration, ownership and a commitment to delivering high-quality results are at the heart of how we work.

**Joybuy**
is looking for a commercially driven Category Manager with strong knowledge of Asian food products and a good understanding of the Dutch food retail market. Based in the Netherlands, you will be responsible for developing a competitive product assortment, building supplier partnerships and driving category growth. Combining your understanding of Asian food trends with local market insights, you will help shape our food offering to meet the needs of Dutch consumers while delivering sustainable sales and margin growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy & Performance: Own the commercial performance of assigned food categories, driving GMV, gross margin, sales growth, product availability and inventory turnover.
* Market & Consumer Insights: Develop a strong understanding of the Dutch food market, including local consumer preferences, shopping behaviors, retail trends and the competitive landscape. Identify opportunities to expand and optimize the Asian food assortment.
* Supplier Sourcing & Development: Identify, evaluate and develop relationships with food suppliers, brands, importers and distributors, leveraging knowledge of Asian food products and the Dutch supplier landscape.
* Assortment Management: Build and optimize a relevant, competitive assortment of Asian food products based on consumer demand, local market trends, product quality and commercial potential.
* Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate purchase prices, payment terms, rebates, promotional support and other trading conditions to improve category profitability and strengthen supplier partnerships.
* Pricing & Promotions: Develop competitive pricing and promotional strategies aligned with the Dutch market to drive sales and customer growth while maintaining healthy margins.
* Inventory Management: Work closely with Supply Chain and Operations on demand forecasting, replenishment and stock optimization to ensure product availability and minimize overstock, aged inventory and food waste.
* Category Performance Analysis: Monitor sales, margins, pricing, inventory and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable business plans.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance and other commercial teams to deliver category targets and improve the customer proposition.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or above.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in buying, procurement, merchandising or category management, preferably in food, FMCG, grocery retail or e-commerce.
* Strong knowledge of Asian food products, including key product categories, brands, consumer trends and supplier landscapes.
* Good understanding of the Dutch food retail market, including local consumer preferences, retail channels, competitive dynamics and market-specific product requirements.
* Experience sourcing food products and managing relationships with suppliers, importers, distributors or manufacturers.
* Proven commercial negotiation skills and the ability to drive sales growth, margin improvement and category performance.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills, with experience in assortment planning, pricing and inventory management.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to work independently and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English. Dutch or Chinese language skills are a plus.
* Based in the Netherlands or willing to relocate.

Category Manager Vers @ DekaMarkt (Velsen-Noord, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
*De afdeling Commercie is verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop, het assortiment en de promoties van alle producten binnen meer dan 100 DekaMarkt-supermarkten. Vers vormt daarbij een onderscheidende pijler binnen het totale assortiment en speelt een belangrijke rol in de positionering van DekaMarkt.*

*Als Category Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor één of meerdere vers categorieën. Je ontwikkelt en realiseert een onderscheidende categorievisie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop, assortimentsstrategie en promotiekalender. Daarbij vertaal je klantinzichten, marktontwikkelingen en commerciële kansen naar een aantrekkelijk en rendabel assortiment dat aansluit bij de behoeften van onze klanten.*

**Dit is jouw baan**

Samen met een gedreven team ben je dagelijks verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van een onderscheidend, kwalitatief sterk en commercieel aantrekkelijk vers aanbod in onze supermarkten. Als Category Manager werk je nauw samen met de Assistent Category Managers en draag je onder andere zorg voor:

* Het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van category plannen, gebaseerd op marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en trends
* Het monitoren en optimaliseren van prijsstellingen en marges
* Het samenstellen en continu verbeteren van een onderscheidend en winstgevend assortiment
* Het ontwikkelen van een heldere schap-visie en het vertalen hiervan naar een optimale presentatie op de winkelvloer
* Het opzetten en realiseren van effectieve promotie- en activatieplannen
* Het voeren van operationele en tactische onderhandelingen met leveranciers
* Het signaleren, analyseren en vertalen van relevante interne en externe ontwikkelingen naar commerciële kansen

**Dit krijg je terug voor jouw inzet**

Samen met een enthousiast team werk je aan het behalen van de afdelingsdoelstellingen. Tegelijkertijd krijg je veel ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise bij te dragen, initiatief te nemen en impact te maken. We dagen je uit om het maximale uit jouw kwaliteiten te halen.

Daarnaast ontvang je uitstekende primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals:

* Afhankelijk van ervaring een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.987,- en € 7.235,- per maand op basis van 40 uur per week (wij betalen uit per 4 weken)
* Afhankelijk van de functieschaal een variabele beloning van maximaal 16%
* 8% vakantiegeld
* 30 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis
* Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon
* Een goede pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot deelname aan collectieve zorgverzekeringen en private leaseregeling
* Flexibele werktijden
* Interne opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden waarmee je vakinhoudelijke trainingen kunt volgen
* Een ‘menukaart’ waardoor je flexibel arbeidsvoorwaarden uit kan ruilen voor andere voorwaarden die beter bij je passen, zoals meer vakantiedagen of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding

**Een goede werkgever**

Wij zijn DekaMarkt. Met meer dan 100 filialen, twee distributiecentra, een eigen transporttak, honderdduizenden klanten per week en ruim 8.000 collega’s zijn we een toonaangevende speler in de Nederlandse food Retail.

Als familiebedrijf zijn we sterk lokaal geworteld. Persoonlijk contact staat centraal: met onze klanten, collega’s en leveranciers. We kennen veel van onze klanten en telers persoonlijk en werken dagelijks samen aan kwaliteit, versheid en een onderscheidend aanbod. Onze klanten kiezen voor ons omdat zij lekker en goed eten belangrijk vinden en dit willen kopen in een supermarkt waar kwaliteit, vers beleving, service en persoonlijk contact centraal staan.

Binnen onze organisatie staan veiligheid, gezondheid en persoonlijke ontwikkeling voorop. We geloven in het benutten van talent, geven verantwoordelijkheid en stimuleren eigenaarschap. Door heldere communicatie, samenwerking en ruimte voor initiatief behalen we samen ambitieuze doelstellingen. Zo creëren we een omgeving waarin jij kunt groeien en bouwen aan jouw carrière.

**Dit neem jij mee**

Je bent een ervaren, besluitvaardige professional met een sterk analytisch vermogen en een scherp commercieel inzicht. Dankzij jouw strategische en conceptuele denkkracht ben je in staat complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en te vertalen naar heldere, concrete oplossingen. Daarbij fungeer je als een stevige sparringpartner voor de Unit Manager.

Daarnaast ben je sterk in het opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties, zowel intern als extern, en neem je van nature initiatief. Met jouw overtuigingskracht en communicatieve vaardigheden weet je stakeholders mee te nemen en te verbinden om gezamenlijke doelstellingen te realiseren.

Je bent resultaatgericht, ondernemend en werkt doelbewust toe naar concrete en meetbare resultaten.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* Meerdere jaren ervaring als Category Manager of in een vergelijkbare commerciële rol binnen retail, bij voorkeur binnen een supermarktformule
* Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van category strategieën en assortimentsplannen
* Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en ruime ervaring met data-analyse en rapportagetools, waaronder advanced Excel
* Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een commerciële richting, zoals Commerciële Economie, Bedrijfskunde of Retailmanagement
* Ervaring op de winkelvloer en/of binnen inkoopmanagement is een pre, evenals aantoonbare affiniteit met vers
* Een sterke commerciële drive, resultaatgerichte instelling en een scherp oog voor kansen in de markt

**Geïnteresseerd? We zien jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet!**

Zie jij jezelf als Category Manager Vers bij DekaMarkt? We verwelkomen je graag.

Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact met Frank ten Duis, Unitmanager Vers. Dit kan via ftduis@dekamarkt.nl.

***Met deze vacature willen wij zelf onze nieuwe collega werven. Dit is dan ook géén oproep voor acquisitie.***

job.title: Category-manager @ Hoogvliet supermarkt (Bleiswijk, South Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
“Yes! Weer een sterke deal binnengehaald voor het komende seizoen!” Als ervaren Category Manager in de food-retail weet jij als geen ander hoe uitdagend én inspirerend het is om jaarplannen en onderscheidende schappresentaties te ontwikkelen voor jouw assortimentsgroepen. Dankzij jouw commerciële scherpte, marktkennis en creatieve visie verras je onze klanten steeds weer met een aantrekkelijk, innovatief én kwalitatief sterk assortiment. En daar ben je trots op. Met jouw onderhandelingskracht, ondernemersmentaliteit en oog voor kansen lever je een directe bijdrage aan onze ambitie: keer op keer de verwachtingen van onze klanten overtreffen.

DIT GA JE DOEN ALS CATEGORY MANAGER

Als Category Manager bepaal jij de koers voor jouw assortimentsgroepen. Je selecteert en optimaliseert het assortiment op basis van marktontwikkelingen, klantdata en performance-analyses. Je ontwikkelt doordachte jaarplannen, vertaalt strategie naar schappresentaties die echt werken en creëert effectieve promotie- en activatieplannen. Ook zorg je voor sterke interne afstemming, zodat iedereen van fabrikant tot winkel exact weet wat nodig is voor succes.

Daarnaast ben je volledig commercieel verantwoordelijk voor omzet, marge en groei binnen jouw categorieën. Je geeft functioneel leiding aan een Assistent Category Manager en fungeert als sparringpartner voor de Unit Manager op categorie-overstijgende thema’s en formuleontwikkeling. In deze rol verwachten we dat je proactief stuurt op resultaat, continu verbetert en kansen in de markt als eerste ziet én benut.

DIT BRENG JE MEE ALS CATEGORY MANAGER

* Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Commerciële Economie of Small Business & Retail Management
* Minimaal 4 à 5 jaar ervaring als Category Manager binnen de food-retail
* Een scherp ontwikkeld commercieel instinct en strategisch inzicht
* Ervaring met categorymanagement op medior niveau, inclusief onderhandelingen en margeoptimalisatie
* Analytische vaardigheden om klantdata, markttrends en schapprestaties te vertalen naar concrete keuzes
* Een overtuigende communicator die makkelijk schakelt met interne én externe stakeholders
* Resultaatgericht, initiatiefrijk en altijd op zoek naar verbeterkansen

CONTINU VERWACHTINGEN OVERTREFFEN

Dat verwachten we niet alleen van jou, dat mag je ook van ons verwachten. Zo bieden we je niet alleen een veelzijdige functie in een dynamische werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega’s, maar ook:

* Een salaris tussen de € 4.700 en € 5.800 per 4 weken o.b.v. 40 uur. Je ontvangt dus 13 keer per jaar salaris
* Een dienstverband van 36 uur per week
* Een auto en mobiele telefoon van de zaak
* 24 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van 40 uur, reiskostenvergoeding en 8% vakantiegeld
* Een niet-ziek-bonus die kan oplopen tot maximaal 2,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
* De mogelijkheid om (deels) vanuit huis te werken
* 10% korting op je boodschappen tot een maximum van maar liefst € 500,- per jaar. De korting betalen we uit via je salaris
* Een individueel opleidingsbudget
* Gratis gebruik van de fitnessruimte op ons Hoofdkantoor

WORD JIJ ONZE NIEUWE CATEGORY MANAGER?

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteren is heel gemakkelijk, klik op onderstaande sollicitatiebutton en de rest wijst zich vanzelf.

We willen je nog wel laten weten dat een integriteitscontrole via het waarschuwingsregister van de stichting Fraude Aanpak Detailhandel onderdeel is van de sollicitatieprocedure.

job.title: Global Portfolio and Brand Lead - Intimate Health @ Karo Healthcare (Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a
**Global Portfolio and Brand Lead - Intimate Health**
for our office in Rotterdam.

**What's in it for you?**

**Ready to shape the future of a global healthcare category?**

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of our Intimate Health portfolio and drive the global growth of Pevaryl, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

You'll have the freedom to
**shape category strategy, accelerate innovation and influence commercial decisions**
across international markets. Working with talented, cross-functional teams, you'll play a pivotal role in building brands, identifying growth opportunities and delivering meaningful results in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

**What you'll be doing**

* **Own the global category strategy:**
  Develop and deliver the 3-5 year Intimate Health category strategy, defining portfolio priorities, growth opportunities and long-term direction
* **Drive portfolio growth:**
  Identify new market opportunities, consumer needs and category trends to optimise the portfolio and unlock sustainable, profitable growth
* **Lead innovation:**
  Build and prioritise a commercially focused innovation pipeline, taking ideas from consumer insight and concept development through to launch
* **Shape the future of Pevaryl:**
  Own the global brand strategy and 1-3 year growth plan, strengthening brand positioning, communication and activation across key markets
* **Deliver impactful brand execution:**
  Develop global brand assets, digital-first toolkits and activation guidelines that enable local teams to succeed
* **Turn insight into action:**
  Use consumer, market, competitor and commercial data to identify opportunities, build business cases and make informed investment decisions
* **Collaborate internationally:**
  Partner with Marketing, Insights, R&D, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance and local markets to bring strategies and innovations to life
* **Champion performance:**
  Monitor category and brand performance, identify opportunities for improvement and drive commercial results
* **Influence and lead:**
  Act as a key global stakeholder, aligning cross-functional teams, challenging existing thinking and driving clear, commercially focused decisions

**Requirements**

* **7+ years of experience**
  in Category Management, Portfolio Management, Innovation or Brand Management, ideally within FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, OTC or Health & Beauty
* Proven experience developing category or portfolio strategies and translating them into successful commercial growth plans
* Strong brand-building expertise, including positioning, innovation, communication development and go-to-market activation
* A commercially driven mindset, with experience in business cases, investment decisions, portfolio performance and budget management
* Ability to translate consumer insights, market trends and competitive intelligence into actionable growth opportunities
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, ideally across multiple international markets
* Strong analytical, strategic and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and deliver results
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence senior leaders
* A degree in Business, Marketing, Innovation, Life Sciences or a related field
* A proactive, collaborative and entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluent English and proficiency in Microsoft Office

Above all, we're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo. Someone who can think strategically, act decisively and bring people together to deliver results.

**Benefits**

* Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage
* Apart from a competitive salary pack, there are lots of growth opportunities to meet your personal ambitions
* Flexible schedule and life-work balance
* Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects that have a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry
* Very positive work environment in a young, international, and motivated team
* Start-up spirit while being a part of a large international organisation with strong values

*Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.*

job.title: Regional Category Manager @ Nouryon (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
**Take the lead in shaping Nouryon’s regional sourcing agenda for Raw Materials . As Regional Category Manager, you will drive key commercial decisions, lead impactful negotiations, and develop strong, long-term supplier relationships with focus on specific Categories. If you enjoy strategic responsibility, working with data, and influencing senior stakeholders, this role gives you a platform to visibly contribute to our regional performance.**
**About the job**
**Our Direct Procurement team is a global group of 45 professionals managing Nouryon’s strategic raw material base — a portfolio with significant impact on our cost position, product quality, and sustainability agenda. Around 20 colleagues are based in our modern office in Amsterdam-Zuidoost, with others embedded in key regions close to our markets and suppliers. The team works closely with Manufacturing, R&D, Finance, Sustainability, and our business units to ensure reliable, cost-effective, and sustainable supply.**
**As Regional Category Manager you will play a key role in this team, with end-to-end responsibility for both Strategic categories e.g. Sodium Silicate and Transactional Categories. These categories are directly tied to Nouryon’s core business performance in your region. You will have significant visibility and the autonomy to define and implement regional category strategies, run and optimize tenders, and build long-term supplier partnerships that directly support Nouryon’s growth and performance.**
**In your future role as Regional Category Manager you will**

* Develop and implement regional sourcing strategies and multi-year roadmaps for Sodium Silicate and Transactional Categories, balancing cost, supply security, sustainability, and innovation.
* Translate global category strategies into regional execution plans, ensuring alignment with regional business priorities and market conditions.
* Conduct regional market intelligence, cost-driver analysis, and risk assessments to identify opportunities, anticipate shifts, and secure competitive advantage.
* Lead regional contract and price negotiations, securing robust agreements that protect Nouryon’s supply position and deliver sustainable value.
* Plan, manage, and execute regional tenders, leveraging digital procurement platforms (e.g. Coupa) to drive transparency, compliance, and savings.
* Serve as the primary procurement contact for Business Line and functional stakeholders in your region, translating business needs into sourcing and supplier strategies.
* Collaborate with Operations, R&D, Supply Chain, Finance, and Quality to align specifications, optimize total cost of ownership, and support product and process improvements.
* Execute supplier segmentation and conduct supplier performance reviews, identifying and implementing improvement and development initiatives.
* Support and lead cost-out programs, value engineering initiatives, and total cost of ownership improvements that strengthen Nouryon’s margin and competitiveness in the region.

We believe you bring
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Chemistry, or related field.
* At least 5 years working experience in strategic procurement or category management, with a track record in complex commodity categories, preferably in chemical raw materials.
* Experience with managing strategic raw material categories at regional level and running tenders, ideally using platforms such as Coupa.
* Proven success managing complex, high-value regional spend portfolios, including responsibility for more than one category and/or multiple countries within a region.
* Solid negotiation experience with senior supplier and internal stakeholders, with the ability to align different functions and secure strong commercial outcomes.
* Strong strategic and analytical skills, with the ability to work with data, understand regional market dynamics, and translate insights into clear category strategies.
* Fluency in English, both verbal and written.
* Ability to work independently and proactively, managing several parallel projects and priorities across regional categories.

Great if you have
  
**· Knowledge of or exposure to chemical raw materials such as Sodium Silicate or related commodity markets.**
**· Affinity with procurement systems such as SAP and Ariba, and experience with Coupa or similar tendering tools.**

**We believe you are**

* A natural connector who builds trusted relationships at all levels
* Commercially driven and outcome-focused, always connecting procurement decisions to measurable business impact
* Analytically sharp, able to cut through complexity and translate market data into clear strategic choices

**We offer you**
This is a high-impact role offering genuine strategic ownership of two significant regional categories. You will work alongside a mature and high-performing procurement team, with direct access to senior leadership, global business lines, and a supply base spanning multiple countries. Our employment package comprises :
  

* A permanent contract with a probationary period of 2 months.
* A gross basic annual salary including holiday allowance based on your knowledge and experience between EUR 77.000 and EUR 115.000.
* 25 vacation days + 10 leave days.
* A performance bonus based on KPI’s.
* An excellent pension plan with a strong contribution rate, most of which is paid by Nouryon.
* LifeCheck Employee Assistance Program: Free, confidential wellbeing support for you and your family.
* Bright, modern offices with excellent public transport connections.
* An attractive bike plan.
* A company fitness plan to stay active and healthy

**Good to know**
This is a permanent, full-time position based in Amsterdam (Amsterdam-Zuid Oost). You will report directly to the Regional Procurement Manager, who is also based in Amsterdam.
  
  
Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!
  
  
**About Nouryon**
Explore careers and life at Nouryon
  
  
If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.
  
  
Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn .

job.title: Global Category Manager Mechanical Equipment @ Vanderlande (Veghel, North Brabant, Netherlands)
job.description:
Job Title
  
  
Global Category Manager Mechanical Equipment
  
  
**Job Description**
**Are you a strategic procurement professional who knows how to turn market insights and business needs into impactful category strategies? Do you enjoy working in an international environment where you can influence supplier partnerships, sourcing decisions, and business performance on a global scale?**
Vanderlande is looking for a Global Category Manager to develop and execute category strategies and lead strategic sourcing initiatives for assigned spend areas. As part of the global Procurement organization, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify sourcing opportunities, and implement sustainable procurement solutions that support Vanderlande's business goals. You will ensure alignment of category strategies across regions and projects while driving cost, quality, innovation, and supplier performance.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables our projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks via the procurement of goods and services in the smartest, cost-effective and sustainable way. We ensure a resilient and competitive supplier ecosystem and aim to advance towards best-in-class practices, and ensure the organization is efficient, effective, and future-proof. Furthermore, our procurement organization plays an important role in Vanderlande's transformation from an Engineer-to-Order (ETO) to a Configure-to-Order (CTO) business model. This new model aims at enhancing value for its customers through increased standardization, scalability, and more competitive solutions.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
As a Global Category Manager, you will be responsible for managing assigned categories on a global scale, translating business requirements into sourcing strategies, and leading end-to-end strategic sourcing initiatives. This includes developing sourcing and RfX documents, evaluating supplier proposals, leading commercial negotiations, conducting auctions, and managing supplier communications throughout the sourcing process.
  
  
In this role, you will define and drive category strategies, ensuring their effective implementation across regions and projects. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to deliver value, mitigate risk, and support business objectives. Additionally, you will serve as the Supplier Relationship Manager for a designated portfolio of strategic suppliers, fostering long-term partnerships and driving continuous performance improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Managing assigned categories, including gathering business requirements, creating/modifying project charters and plans within the Category Management tool, support the contract creation process, support the supplier onboarding process, etc.
* Lead and/or support in strategic and complex sourcing events, with tasks such as the creation of the sourcing projects within the S2P Suite, creation of RfX documents, evaluation of proposal based on pre-defined criteria, support the negotiation process, etc.
* Develop and implement strategies to mitigate supplier-related risks, ensuring business continuity and minimizing potential disruptions
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all supplier performance-related activities, facilitating deep channels of communication between suppliers and internal stakeholders
* Support supplier segmentation to categorize suppliers based on strategic importance and develop tailored supplier performance management strategies
* Identify performance gaps and initiate and oversee supplier improvement programs to enhance performance and address deficiencies
* When required, review details within Purchase Requisitions (PR) for non-catalog items and request clarification from requester(s)
* Coordinate the modification of Item Master Data for assigned categories (suppliers, items, catalogs, prices, etc.) with support from MDM Specialists

**What do we ask from you?**
To be successful in this role, you should have
  
  

* University degree in economics or technical degree with business background
* Fluent in English, spoken and written (mandatory)
* Experience (+3 years) in procurement or supply chain management, with a strong understanding of category management processes
* Knowledge and practical experience with sourcing methodologies and tools, with familiarity with S2P suites being a plus
* Proven ability to support the establishment and management of sourcing events, including stakeholder communication, documentation, and process execution
* Experience in developing and maintaining documentation to ensure high-quality and standardized category coordination activities
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
* Ability to travel internationally up to 30% of the time

**About The Team**
Our Supply Management team in Procurement is a dynamic and collaborative group of procurement professionals dedicated to optimizing both direct and indirect spend across the organization. Our team comprises of category experts and supplier relationship managers who develop and implement tailored procurement strategies that align with local market dynamics while supporting global objectives. We cultivate robust supplier partnerships, negotiate competitive contracts, and identify opportunities for cost savings, always enhancing efficiency and value. By working closely with demand management, procurement centers of excellence, and external suppliers, we ensure all procurement activities comply with regulations and support overall business goals. Through strong relationships and effective communication across regional and global teams, we drive sustainable procurement performance and support the organization in achieving its strategic objectives.
  
  
**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande is the global market leader for future-proof logistic process automation at airports and in the parcel market. Furthermore, we are also a leading supplier of process automation solutions for warehouses, which seamlessly integrate innovative systems, intelligent software and life-cycle services.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you can develop your career, satisfy your ambitions, aspire to new heights, while enjoying personal growth and thriving on achievement.
  
  
**What We Offer**
In the challenging and responsible position of Global Category Manager, you will have the chance to make a significant contribution to industry-leading projects and be connected to our dedicated people and customers. We offer a position in an informal, international and professional working environment with a lot of scope for personal development. By joining our profitable and growing company you will be able to reach your goals and focus on your future.
  
  
This position offers a competitive salary range of €5.700,- to €7.000,- gross per month (excluding 8% holiday allowance). Through exceeding performance expectations, you even have the possibility to grow outside this scale.
  
  
On top of your fixed salary you’ll receive the following secondary benefits
  
  

* 40 vacation days (20 statutory days and a flexible budget worth 20 days).
* Flexible working hours.
* A hybrid workplace (40% working from home and 60% in the office)
* A Health & Wellbeing budget worth €300,- per calendar year
* Commuting allowance, including full reimbursement of travel by public transport.
* Working from home allowance.
* Collective pension scheme and discount on additional health insurance
* On-site company health centres with a gym, physiotherapists and occupational therapists
* Vanderlande Academy and training facilities to boost your skills
* A variety in Vanderlande Network communities and initiatives
* And a great company restaurant and coffee bar with barista

**Contact**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV. Questions about this role? Contact Carlijn Kneepkens (Recruiter) at carlijn.kneepkens@vanderlande.com.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

Wir haben ein eigenes Fitnessstudio mit regelmäßigen Kursen, einen Ruheraum, eine Dachterrasse, Bio-Kaffee, eine Cafeteria, 100% grünen Strom und eine Masseurin, die einmal pro Woche vorbeikommt.

**Was bringst du mit?**

job.title: Business Development Manager - Aviation (m/w/d) @ Ehrhardt + Partner GmbH & Co. KG (Aachen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany)
job.description:

Logistik-Consulting, Cloud-Services, Managed Services und Logistik-Schulungen in der eigenen Akademie runden das umfassende Lösungsangebot der EPG ab.

Um auch langfristig in Richtung Erfolg zu gehen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

**Business Development Manager - Aviation (m/w/d)**

  
**Aufgaben**
  

Sie werden Teil der topsystem GmbH und damit Teil der EPG. Als Business Development Manager (m/w/d) für unsere verschiedenen Softwarelösungen spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle beim Ausbau der Aviation Execution Suite (AES) der EPG. Sie treiben die Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten voran und übernehmen die Verantwortung für den Aufbau und das Wachstum unserer AES-Präsenz im Luftfahrtsektor, vor allem im amerikanischen Markt. Als Bindeglied zwischen EPG und unseren Kunden verstehen Sie die Herausforderungen des Flugbetriebs und wissen, wie man innovative Softwarelösungen positioniert. Mit Beharrlichkeit, Marktkenntnis und ausgeprägtem Vertriebsantrieb gewinnen Sie neue Kunden und gestalten die Zukunft der digitalen Luftfahrt sowie der Abläufe im Ground Handling mit.

**DIE AUFGABEN - Damit bewirken Sie etwas**

* Sie identifizieren und entwickeln Markteintritts- und Wachstumsstrategien für unsere Aviation Execution Suite (AES) in Europa und Amerika.
* Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, potenzielle Kunden in der Luftfahrtbranche zu identifizieren, anzusprechen und zu gewinnen, mit besonderem Fokus auf Flughäfen, Bodenabfertigungsdienstleister und andere Akteure der Luftfahrtbranche.
* Sie planen und leiten Kundentermine, Produktpräsentationen und Workshops mit starkem Fokus auf den Luftfahrtbetrieb und den Mehrwert unserer AES-Lösungen.
* Sie analysieren Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnisse und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten im Umfeld der Luftfahrt und des Flughafenbetriebs.
* Sie bauen langfristige Beziehungen zu bestehenden Kunden, Partnern und Schlüsselkunden auf, entwickeln und pflegen diese durch kontinuierliche Betreuung und strategische Geschäftsentwicklung.
* Sie unterstützen unsere Marketingaktivitäten und nehmen an internationalen Fachkonferenzen, Messen und anderen Veranstaltungen teil.
  

**Profil**

* Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss mit Schwerpunkt auf Betriebswirtschaft und/oder Luftfahrtmanagement. Alternativ haben Sie eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Sie verfügen über Erfahrung in der Geschäftsentwicklung oder im Vertrieb und konnten idealerweise in diesem Bereich bereits Ihre interkulturellen Kompetenzen unter Beweis stellen.
* Erfahrung in der Luftfahrtbranche ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
* Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe IT-Affinität aus und haben Freude daran, sich in komplexe Softwarelösungen einzuarbeiten und diese zu verstehen.
* Sie sind bereit, international zu reisen (z. B. in Amerika).
* Abgerundet wird Ihr Profil durch fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  
**Wir bieten**

Wir glauben daran, dass Arbeit Spaß machen und zum Leben passen darf. Und deshalb gibt es, neben unserem bunten und talentierten Team, den besten Kunden und den unterschiedlichsten Projekten und Produkten noch folgendes dazu:

* **Onboarding zum Ankommen.**
  Onboardingplan vorab, damit Sie wissen, was auf Sie zukommt. Onboardingtag, um uns besser kennenzulernen. Und die Onboardingphase im Fachbereich; so gestaltet, dass Sie bestmöglich ankommen, verstehen und loslegen können.
* **Aufgaben zum Weiterkommen.**
  Dinge bewegen, ab Tag 1. Das heißt bei uns: Verantwortung geben und bekommen. Ideen nicht nur äußern können, sondern umsetzen dürfen. Und ein Personalentwicklungskonzept, das individuell passt - egal, ob Richtung Führungskraft oder Fachexperte.
* **Arbeitszeit und -ort? Flexibel.**
  Unser Gleitzeitmodell bietet die Flexibilität, die zu Ihrer Arbeit und Ihrem Leben passt. Dazu gehört natürlich auch die Möglichkeit, aus dem Homeoffice heraus zu arbeiten.
* **Miteinander und Kultur? Auf Augenhöhe.**
  Offenes Feedback. Regelmäßige Updates durch unsere Geschäftsführung. Lösungsorientiertes An-einem-Strang-Ziehen. Und natürlich auch Get-together-Events wie das Kartfahren, die EPG-Weihnachtsfeier oder unsere LAN-Party - um uns und unsere Erfolge zu feiern.
* **Jetzt. Für später.**
  Die betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) bietet eine gute Möglichkeit, für das Alter vorzusorgen. Dafür gibt es von uns im Heute einen starken Arbeitgeberzuschuss, damit Ihr Morgen so entspannt wie möglich wird.
* **Bewegung. Um lange bewegen zu können.**
  Jeder hat die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu leasen. Oder in unserem Sportraum zu trainieren. Lieber was im Team? Dann bietet sich der Firmenlauf oder ein Nachmittag im Kletterwald an.
* **Branche der Gegenwart. Und Zukunft.**
  Die Welt der Logistik begleitet nicht nur unser aller Alltag. Sie ist auch essenziell für eine nachhaltige, lebenswerte Zukunft. Was das bedeutet? Viel, was wir gemeinsam bewegen können. Die Möglichkeit, Dinge besser zu machen. Und einen sicheren, auch für die Zukunft relevanten, Arbeitsplatz.
* Und klar, Obstkorb und Getränke haben wir natürlich auch.

  
**Important note**
Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered.

marta baut die stundenweise Betreuung für pflegebedürftige Menschen auf. Wir wollen unseren Umsatz in den nächsten zwölf Monaten verdoppeln und in den siebenstelligen ARR-Bereich wachsen, bundesweit. Wir wollen den Pflegemarkt umkrempeln, und dafür suchen wir jemanden, der voll angreift.
  
  
**Deine Rolle in unserem Team**

* Du treibst unser Wachstum. Neue Regionen und Partner erschließen, zum Laufen bringen und skalieren. Der Umsatz, den du aufbaust, ist deine Zahl.
* Du baust das Operating System für den Rollout. Du denkst in Prozessen und nutzt AI, um sie zu bauen, zu iterieren und zu skalieren.

* 1 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem schnellen Startup, in der Beratung oder im VC
* Erfahrung im Partner Management ist ein Plus
* Du denkst in Prozessen und Zahlen und setzt AI selbstverständlich ein
* Du willst Verantwortung und Tempo
* Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch

**Warum marta?**

* Die Chance auf deinen eigenen Bereich. Wenn du richtig ablieferst, baust du ihn auf und führst ihn.
* Ein krasses Lernumfeld. Du übernimmst früh echte Verantwortung und wirst gleichzeitig gezielt gefördert.
* Ein sehr dynamisches Umfeld mit Mission: Pflege muss besser werden, und du machst sie besser.

**Über uns**
**Warum wir marta gegründet haben**
Als wir nach einer 24-Stunden-Betreuung für unsere Angehörigen suchten, fühlten wir uns auf einem undurchsichtigen und oft überteuerten Markt allein gelassen. Besonders frustrierend war die Erkenntnis, dass ein Großteil des Gehalts, das wir für die Betreuung zahlten, nicht bei den Pflegekräften ankam. Nach fünf Jahren erfolgloser Suche nach einer vertrauenswürdigen Lösung beschlossen wir 2020, marta zu gründen, um den Markt der 24-Stunden-Pflege fairer und transparenter zu gestalten.
  
  
Zu Ehren von Marta, die meine Großeltern jahrelang liebevoll betreut hat, trägt unser Unternehmen ihren Namen.
  
  
**Unsere Mission ist klar:**
Wir glauben, dass Pflegekräfte eine bessere Betreuung leisten, wenn sie unter fairen Arbeits- und Lebensbedingungen arbeiten. Deshalb haben wir eine Plattform entwickelt, die sowohl Betreuungskräfte als auch Familien mit intelligenten Softwarelösungen unterstützt. Diese ermöglichen eine reibungslose und direkte Zusammenarbeit. Durch niedrigere Vermittlungsgebühren schaffen wir es, dass Pflegekräfte ein höheres Einkommen erzielen, ohne dass die Familien mehr bezahlen müssen.
  
  
Heute sind wir international aktiv, mit Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig. Unterstützt von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, verfolgen wir unsere Vision einer Welt, in der Pflege bezahlbar, transparent und verlässlich ist.

job.title: Business Development Manager @ Airbnb (Berlin, Berlin, Germany)
job.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You'll Join**
The Homes team plays a key role in shaping the Airbnb stays experience. As a multidisciplinary team, we partner with Hosts to build high-quality, repeatable, commercially viable offerings that reflect our brand values.
  
  
We're building something new: a dedicated Business Development function across EMEA, focused entirely on winning new professional supply for Airbnb. This isn't a role that inherits an existing book of business, it's a genuine new-business mandate, and you'll be one of the first people helping shape how we approach it.
  
  
For this role, you'll be at the forefront of expanding Airbnb's professional supply base in one of Europe's most important travel markets, reporting into our Homes EMEA team under the Field Operations Manager.
  
  
**The Difference You'll Make**
You're not managing what already exists, you're building what's next. You'll hunt down new opportunities, win new business, and bring high-quality professional hosts and partners onto Airbnb for the first time.
  
  
No inherited portfolio. No fixed playbook. Just a market to win, and the autonomy to figure out exactly how to win it. You'll own the full deal, sourcing, pipeline, negotiation, signature, onboarding, and shape how Airbnb approaches new supply acquisition from the ground up.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Genuine new-business, hunter-style sales experience, not account management
* A proven track record of personally sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals end-to-end
* Comfort operating without an established playbook, and the drive to build your own approach
* A self-directed, entrepreneurial mindset, you create opportunities rather than wait for them
* Strong commercial instinct and the ability to think strategically about a market
* Confidence taking full personal ownership of a deal, from first conversation to signed contract

**A Typical Day**

* Prospect and onboard new, high quality professional hosts in your assigned territory, continuously building and managing a strong pipeline
* Create and deploy scaled strategies to effectively acquire Professional Hosts in your region
* Represent Airbnb in external meetings with Professional Hosts, showing up as a credible and knowledgeable market expert
* Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and act on strategic opportunities in your region to drive sales growth
* Develop deep knowledge of your assigned geographic markets across DACH
* Build and manage partner relationships within your assigned territory
* Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integration of various software partners so that you can provide the right support to your clients
* Educate clients on all significant product changes and cascade feedback on product and policy to relevant internal stakeholders
* Respond to and deliver exceptional service to your professional hosts in a timely and efficient manner
* Work cross-functionally with product, communications, public policy and customer support teams to ensure our long-term market success

**Your Expertise**

* 6+ years of experience in sales
* 2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have)
* Strong time management and prioritization skills
* Strong B2B sales/new business development experience
* Ability to work at both strategic and tactical levels, with a proven track record to execute in ambiguous environments
* Excellent communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with clients
* Experience building and strengthening relationships with external partners
* Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results
* Available to travel to assigned markets
* Ability to work within tight deadlines, adjust to changes in priorities, and balance short-term needs with long-term strategic initiatives
* Hospitality/travel industry experience in the region is a plus
* Highly proficient in using CRM software - Salesforce experience is a plus
* Charismatic self-starter who is resourceful and self-sufficient
* Fluency in German and English

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
#ind
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
Germany Annual Pay Range
  
  
€71.000—€84.000 EUR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Seit 2018 wachsen wir als digitale Marke kontinuierlich und erreichen jeden Monat hunderttausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Hinter diesem Wachstum steht ein Team, das Verantwortung übernimmt, pragmatisch arbeitet und Dinge wirklich umsetzt.

Wir sind eine 100 % Remote Company innerhalb Deutschlands. Das heißt: eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, klare Kommunikation und ein Umfeld, in dem gute Ideen zählen.

#### **DEINE ROLLE**

Als Growth Campaign Manager verantwortest du den gesamten Kampagnen- und Aktionskalender unseres D2C-Onlineshops – von der Planung über die Steuerung aller beteiligten Teams bis zur Erfolgsmessung.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Kampagnen, Produktlaunches und Angebote über Shop, App, Newsletter, Social und Paid hinweg konsistent, aufeinander abgestimmt und wirkungsvoll ausgespielt werden.

Die Rolle berichtet an die Head of E-Commerce.

#### **DAS SIND DEINE AUFGABEN**

**Kampagnenmanagement D2C-Onlineshop (End-to-End-Verantwortung)**

* Du verantwortest den Kampagnen- und Aktionskalender unseres Onlineshops: Planung, Priorisierung, Freigabe und Nachsteuerung aller Kampagnen im Jahresverlauf.
* Du entscheidest, wann welche Kampagne mit welchem Offer (Rabatt, Bundle, Gratisprodukt, Staffelpreis, Loyalty-Benefit) über welche Kanäle läuft, inklusive Zielmix aus Neukunden und Bestandskunden.
* Du briefst und steuerst alle beteiligten Teams (CRM, CRO, Merchandising, Content/Creative, Social, Performance) vom Konzept bis zum Go-live.
* Du stellst ein konsistentes Kampagnenerlebnis über Shop, Newsletter, App, Social und Paid sicher.
* Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Brand Kampagnen auf die restliche Planung abgestimmt sind und wo sinnvoll Synergien entstehen.

**Kampagnen-Aussteuerung über die App**

* Du planst und steuerst Kampagnen und Offers in der NATURTREU-App (Push, In-App-Banner, App-exklusive Angebote).
* Du stimmst App- und Shop-Kampagnen so aufeinander ab, dass sich beide Kanäle ergänzen statt zu kannibalisieren.

**Produktlaunch-Kampagnen**

* Du planst und steuerst die Launch-Kampagnen im Shop und in der App für neue Produkte – von Timing im Aktionskalender über das Launch-Offer (z. B. Einführungspreis, Bundle, Early Access für Bestandskunden) bis zu Kanalmix und Landingpage.
* Du stimmst dich eng mit Category/Produkt zu Verfügbarkeit, Positionierung und Launch-Terminen ab und bettest den Launch in den systematischen Launch-Prozess ein.
* Du wertest jeden Launch nach festen Kriterien aus (Erstkäufe, Neukundenanteil, Cross-Selling, Wiederkauf) und überführst die Learnings ins Launch-Playbook.

**KPI-Dashboard und Kampagnen-Reporting**

* Du baust ein KPI-Dashboard zur Messung aller Kampagnen auf (Umsatz, Marge nach Rabatt, Bestellungen, AOV, Neukundenanteil, CAC, Wiederkaufsrate, Kanal-Beitrag).
* Du führst regelmäßige Kampagnen-Reviews durch und leitest daraus Learnings für die nächste Planung ab.
* Du stimmst dich eng mit dem Data-Team zu Datenquellen (DWH, Admetrics, Shopify, Klaviyo) und Kennzahl-Definitionen ab.

**Support bei übergreifenden Themen**

* **Paketbeileger:** Du planst Inhalte, Offer-Logik und Erfolgsmessung.
* **Landingpage-Optimierung:** Du optimierst gemeinsam mit dem CRO-Team Landingpages für Kampagnen und Performance Marketing
* **Leadgenerierung:** Du unterstützt CRM und Performance dabei relevante Leads zu sammeln und mit den richtigen Kampagnen zu konvertieren
* **Pricing und Offers:** Du wirkst an Rabattlogik, Preisarchitektur und Bundle-Strategie mit.
* **Social und Onlineshop:** Du unterstützt dabei, die Verzahnung von Onlineshop und Organic Social Media stärker voranzutreiben

#### **DIESE FÄHIGKEITEN ZEICHNEN DICH AUS**

**Kampagnenerfahrung:** Du hast bereits Kampagnen im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld end-to-end geplant und gesteuert.

**Cross-funktionale Steuerung:** Du briefst und koordinierst souverän Teams aus CRM, CRO, Content, Social und Performance.

**Datenaffinität:** Du liebst KPIs, baust gerne Dashboards und leitest aus Zahlen konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

**E-Commerce-Verständnis:** Du kennst dich mit Shopify, CRM-Systemen und gängigen Marketing-Tools aus (z. B. Klaviyo).

**Projektmanagement:** Du behältst bei mehreren parallel laufenden Kampagnen den Überblick und triffst Prioritäten eigenständig.

**Kommunikationsstärke:** Du formulierst komplexe Kampagnen-Briefings klar und verständlich.

**KI-Affinität:** Du hast Interesse daran, KI-Tools sinnvoll in Kampagnenplanung und -analyse einzusetzen.

**Sprachen:** Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

#### **DAS BIETET NATURTREU DIR**

**Impact:** Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für das Kampagnenmanagement eines wachsenden D2C-Onlineshops und prägst maßgeblich, wie wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden über alle Kanäle hinweg ansprechen.

**100 % Remote Setup:** Du arbeitest vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands mit festem Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Zusätzlich kannst du bis zu 90 Tage pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten.

**Flexible Arbeitszeiten:** Du arbeitest in Vollzeit mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen unserer Erreichbarkeitszeiten flexibel.

**Urlaub:** Du erhältst 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub pro Jahr.

**Betriebliche Altersvorsorge:** Wir unterstützen dich mit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge auf ETF-Basis.

**Mental Health:** Über unsere Plattform OpenUp erhältst du Zugang zu professionellen Coachings, Sessions und Inhalten rund um mentale Gesundheit und persönliches Wohlbefinden.

**Mitarbeiterrabatt:** Unsere Produkte erhältst du selbstverständlich zu vergünstigten Konditionen.

**Firmenevents:** Bei unserer Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier treffen wir uns persönlich und stärken den Teamzusammenhalt.

**Weiterentwicklung:** Mit unserem Wachstum entstehen neue Möglichkeiten, fachlich und persönlich zu wachsen.

Klingt spannend für dich?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, mehr über dich zu erfahren.

#### **Über uns**

Wir sind NATURTREU!

job.description:

Du bist ein echter Kaffeeliebhaber und möchtest Deine Passion zum Beruf machen? Dann komm zu uns nach Bremen, dem Herzen der deutschen Kaffeekultur. Hier bei Melitta Europa - Geschäftsbereich Kaffee - dreht sich alles um das beliebte Heißgetränk Kaffee: vom Filterkaffee, ganze Bohne oder Spezialitätenkaffee. Unsere Jobbereiche sind so vielseitig wie unsere Kaffeesorten: den weltweiten Einkauf der besten Bohnen, unsere Produktion mit Rösterei und Verpackung und die Produktentwicklung neuer Rezepturen oder spannende Aufgaben im Marketing und Vertrieb sowie vieles mehr findest du bei uns in Bremen – wir bieten Dir vielfältige Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem dynamischen und zunehmend internationalen Umfeld, in dem Genuss und die Qualität unserer Markenprodukte im Mittelpunkt stehen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Kaffeegenusses!

**Deine Aufgaben**

  

**Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung der Kategorie Kaffee aktiv mit** und bringst die bestehende Category-Management-Strategie in die Umsetzung**.** Dabei verbindest Du Markt-, Kategorie- und Shopperwissen mit konkreten Empfehlungen für unsere Marken und Handelspartner. Du erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, begleitest Maßnahmen von der Planung bis zur Erfolgsmessung und stärkst so die Position von Melitta als bevorzugtem Partner der Kategorie.

Folgende spannende Aufgaben warten dabei auf Dich:

* **Category-Management-Strategie** **umsetzen:** Du übersetzt die bestehende Category-Management-Strategie in konkrete kanal- und kundenspezifische Maßnahmen. Du priorisierst Initiativen, koordinierst ihre Umsetzung mit den relevanten Schnittstellen und überprüfst, ob sie die angestrebte Wirkung erzielen
